Name: Zizah
Summary: Second son of Jahath, named in the Gershonite reckoning.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:11: Second son of Jahath, named in the Gershonite reckoning.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zizah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
